bug_info.bug_desc: The vectored-mode trap vector address calculation is triggered when either mtvec[0] or stvec[0] is set, regardless of the actual trap target privilege level. This causes a trap to machine mode to incorrectly use vectored addressing when only stvec is in vectored mode, or vice versa, violating the RISC-V ISA requirement that mtvec and stvec modes are independent.
bug_info.fix_hint: Gate the vectored-mode condition with the trap target privilege level: use mtvec[0] only when trapping to M-mode and stvec[0] only when trapping to S-mode. Replace the OR of both mode bits with a mux selected by trap_to_priv_lvl.
